title: Add refresh tokens so users are not logged out every 15 minutes
task: Users get logged out every 15 minutes. Add refresh tokens with a 30-day lifetime.
plan:
1. src/middleware/auth.ts: add `signRefreshToken(user)` using the same JWT_SECRET with expiresIn '30d' and a claim `type: 'refresh'`.
2. POST /auth/login returns `{ access_token, refresh_token }`.
3. New POST /auth/refresh: verify the refresh token with JWT_SECRET, issue a new access token (the refresh token stays valid until it expires).
4. web/src/api.ts: store refresh_token in localStorage next to the access token; on 401, call /auth/refresh and retry once.
5. No schema change: refresh tokens are stateless JWTs.

must_identify: No revocation: stateless 30-day refresh tokens cannot be invalidated on logout, password change, or compromise (the runbook notes rotating JWT_SECRET is the only kill switch and it logs everyone out); needs a server-side record (refresh_tokens table or token family id) and rotation on use

Storage in localStorage exposes a 30-day credential to any XSS; the current code deliberately uses sessionStorage for the 15-minute token; refresh tokens should be httpOnly, Secure, SameSite cookies scoped to /auth/refresh (or at minimum the trade-off must be made explicit)

Same secret for both token types plus requireAuth not checking the `type` claim means a refresh token can be presented as an access token to any protected route for 30 days; requireAuth must reject type=refresh (or use a different key/audience)
nice_to_have: Refresh token rotation with reuse detection
Rate limiting on /auth/refresh and /auth/login (runbook lists missing login rate limiting)
Rolling deploy: both versions must handle the new login response shape; additive so fine
should_not: Approve stateless non-revocable 30-day tokens in localStorage
Spend the review explaining what JWTs are
human_decisions: Accept a refresh_tokens table (and thus a migration) for revocation vs accept non-revocable tokens with a shorter lifetime
Cookie-based refresh (requires CORS/CSRF consideration) vs bearer refresh token
fixture_facts: src/middleware/auth.ts: HS256 with JWT_SECRET, 15m TTL, requireAuth does not check any type claim
web/src/api.ts stores the access token in sessionStorage
docs/ops-runbook.txt: no refresh tokens today; rotating JWT_SECRET invalidates all tokens; no login rate limiting
